name: Fiona
source:
Fiona is a farmhand of Ed's. She's a friend to the family and lives on a ranch about 2 miles from the farm.

Aside from being a horse expert, she is an experienced jack of all trades and is quite useful around the grounds. 

Her love for Equine creatures is obvious, as she spends a good amount of her time around horses

[From [url=https://jiangshiart.com/mbfs/]artist site[/url]]
